rules.rule: Check for urgent features and signs of occupational stress in the health worker
rules.problem: Type and trigger are right and every red-box item is checked for, but two of the page's 'Identify occupational stress' signs are missing: 'Frequent lateness' (Poor attendance at work; no SNOMED concept found, so a documented gap) and 'Diagnosis of long-term condition' (Recent distressing event; could be approximated as (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Chronic disease" "disorder") (qualifier (snomed_concept "New" "qualifier value")))). The red box's 'at work' context is also dropped from the intoxication and behaviour items.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible substance misuse in health worker with occupational stress
rules.problem: Faithful to the page's blanket sentence ('any of the above may have substance misuse, stress, depression/anxiety or burnout'), so possible is right and the OR over all signs is literally supported. Note that the page's column heading 'Possible alcohol or drug problem' is a closer anchor for this arm; firing possible substance misuse on Fatigue alone is page-literal but clinically loose. The AND with Stress at work is a scoping conjunct not on the page but needed to keep common symptoms like Fatigue from firing it for every patient.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible depression in health worker with occupational stress
rules.problem: possible is right; structure matches 'any of the above may have ... depression'. Same scoping note on the Stress at work conjunct.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible anxiety in health worker with occupational stress
rules.problem: possible is right; structure matches 'any of the above may have ... depression/anxiety'.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible burnout in health worker with occupational stress
rules.problem: possible is right; burnout maps to its SNOMED synonym. The page also lists 'stress' as a may-have outcome, which no rule produces; defensible because the trigger is already Stress at work.

rules.rule: Urgent: health worker with occupational stress and intoxication, inappropriate or aggressive behaviour, or suicidal thoughts
rules.problem: Urgent is justified by 'Arrange urgent assessment'; (and stress (or ...)) mirrors 'with occupational stress and any of'. All four red-box items present. Only the 'at work' context of three items is lost (no SNOMED carrier).

summary: No invented content: every condition traces to the page in the right rule and role, and the Urgent priority and four possible diagnoses follow the page's wording. The main gap is omission: the check task and diagnosis ORs leave out two page signs, 'Frequent lateness' and 'Diagnosis of long-term condition'. Secondary: the red box's 'at work' context is dropped from intoxication, inappropriate and aggressive/violent behaviour, and the '>= 4 drinks/session' threshold is not carried by Heavy drinking session.
